subject: reasoning
question: Pointing to a man, Gaurav said, "He is the brother of the daughter of the father of my mother." How is that person related to Gaurav?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/854e449acd75259b0fdb6ee8f851931989fac9f98d9eedc211a9f6a75ae54a7d.png] 

Given: Pointing to a man, Gaurav said, "He is the brother of the daughter of the father of my mother."

Let's break down the statement from Gaurav's perspective:

 
• "my mother": This refers to Gaurav's mother.
 
• "father of my mother": This refers to Gaurav's maternal grandfather.
 
• "daughter of the father of my mother": This refers to the daughter of Gaurav's maternal grandfather. This could be Gaurav's mother or Gaurav's maternal aunt.
 
• "brother of the daughter of the father of my mother": This refers to the brother of either Gaurav's mother or Gaurav's maternal aunt.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54b05a99c091b0370a030ba3e5babfcf1c25fa985a77928c7f3426ae7fb3f3b5.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e9e756a2abc0310ca585456afc934c3b149bfe302a1120f8714d70e7d3730d7.png] 

 

In both cases, the person is Gaurav's Maternal Uncle.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
